Game Overview

In Kill the Sheep, the core idea is straightforward: jump into the frenzy of Kill the Sheep, where precision and timing reign supreme. Navigate tricky platforms in a formidable tractor, smashing through woolly obstacles in charming pixelated style. As speed escalates, sharpen your reflexes and master each jump to achieve high scores in this relentless, sheep-smashing adventure.
